fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/workflow parse a verifier with both fields, refuse them on a builder, a fixer, a check and an agent step, refuse a blank model and an empty glob, and match `**/testdata/**`, `*_test.go` and `.github/**` against sample paths; cmd/rhiza testscript workflow-describe shows both fields for a verifier that sets them (describe-golden regenerated if the --json shape changes).
fields.statement: A leaves or checks step's verifier role takes `low_risk_models` (a model ladder by attempt) and `risky_paths` (path globs, `**` matching any number of directories) beside its `models`, which stays the ladder for risky leaves; setting either on a builder, fixer, check or agent step is refused with an error naming the verifier role, a blank model or empty glob is refused, a role setting neither behaves exactly as today, and `rhiza workflow describe` (text and --json) shows both fields.

fields.acceptance: Tests in internal/run start verifiers from a role with low_risk_models = ["sonnet"], models = ["opus"] and risky_paths = [".github/**"] and find the journalled leaf-session model sonnet for a first-attempt commit touching only internal/x/x.go, and opus for a commit touching .github/workflows/ci.yml, for attempt 2, for a fresh round, for review cycle 2, and when the start HEAD cannot be diffed; a role without low_risk_models starts on models as before.
fields.statement: When the conductor launches a verifier whose role sets `low_risk_models`, it starts it on that ladder only when the leaf is low-risk, and on `models` when the leaf is risky: a file changed between the builder's or fixer's journalled start HEAD and the commit under verification matches one of the role's `risky_paths`, the attempt within the round is past 1, the leaf is in a fresh round, the review cycle is past 1, or the diff cannot be read; the choice is deterministic, with no agent call, and the leaf-session entry journals the model chosen.

fields.acceptance: A test in internal/workflow loads the built-in build and review workflows and finds those ladders and globs on both verifier roles; cmd/rhiza testscript workflow-describe shows them for `rhiza workflow describe build`; `make self-check` passes.
fields.statement: The built-in build workflow's verifier and review workflow's fixed-leaf verifier keep models = ["opus"] and ship low_risk_models = ["sonnet"] and risky_paths covering test infrastructure (*_test.go, **/*_test.go, **/testdata/**, **/main_test.go), hooks (.githooks/**, **/hooks/**), CI (.github/**), workflow files (.rhiza/workflows/**, internal/workflow/builtin/**), migrations (**/migrations/**, **/migrate/**) and retry code (**/*retry*); a project changes them by overriding the workflow, with no new rhiza.* setting.
